第11章气吞丹霞
“这只金蛇就是碧磷五毒？”钱晨从龙雀环里掏出软趴趴的金蛇。
“它是碧磷金线蛇，只是五毒之一，它是我的成名手段，加入十二元辰后，我抢夺了无数药材，财富……为了这只金蛇胚子，我血洗了苗疆一处村寨，甚至杀死了我今生唯一爱过的女人……”齐秋子说道这里，魂魄居然露出了痛苦的神色。
要知道就算他被禁魂符禁劾，也未曾有过这等痛入心扉的表情。
钱晨已经准备冒用乘雾神君的名号，当然要问清楚齐秋子一生的所有细节，哪会错过这等重要剧情，而且他这几天听商旅路人的故事，渐渐也明悟，这些他未曾经历过的人情世故，却能磨练他的道心，让钱晨自己来这么一遭，他大抵是不愿意的。
但让他听听故事，感悟故事里的爱恨情仇种种纠葛，既能爽，又能磨砺道心，何乐不为？
当即拉开小板凳，就听起了齐秋子这一生的经历……
“爱恨情仇啊！”钱晨叹息一声：“你说你一生最敬重自己的授业恩师，你可还有师兄师弟什么的吗？”
“没有了，碧灵五毒教就只有我一人了。”齐秋子漠然道。
“你老师呢？”
“被我毒死了！”
钱晨豁然起身，摇头道：“你这一生，真是自作自受。”
“把《碧灵五毒化身经》复述一遍，详细描述你见十二元辰时的习惯，语气，动作，把用毒手法，还有近期的详细经历也说出来。”
钱晨放下茶摊的帘幕，用一道藏象符遮掩了这里的动静，开始学习模仿齐秋子的一举一动，听他讲述一些人际关系和他伪装的习惯，同时还要参研《碧灵五毒化身经》。这门《碧灵五毒化身经》确实有一些奇思妙想。
虽然创造者只是想触类旁通，炼制一种以毒物为原料的奇特神兵。
但无意中他已经超出了神兵的限制，摸到了一丝中土世界蛊术和神魂化身的左道法术的门路，他炼制的碧磷五毒，拥有活物的特质，能够寄托神魂，在这个世界算得上一种奇妙的神兵。使用者驾驱五毒化身，相当于有五个拥有无匹剧毒的绝世高手，配合默契，联手对敌，创造者甚至开创了一门合击阵法。
他驾驱五毒齐出，在这个世界也曾经留下一段赫赫传说。
钱晨当然不会将神魂离开他现在所居的这座驻世宝阀，想要冒充乘雾神君，他办法可多，这些毒物经过齐秋子的精心炼制，已经有了一丝法器的雏形，就算在中土世界，也是那些旁门左道求之不得的奇虫。
毕竟中土的资源虽然丰富，也比不得这个世界十二元辰实在肆虐太广，收刮了这个世界无数的顶尖灵物，一个是倾尽一界，蕴养几十个顶尖的神兵武者，他们所用的神兵材料，自然尽善尽美，不能比中土那些在结丹大修士和元神真人的压迫下，战战兢兢，而且数量多了千万倍的底层修士。
钱晨将那碧磷金蛇仔细打磨，把齐秋子压箱底的其他火候未纯的四只毒物也拿了出来，一把妙空留下的灵丹灌下去，齐秋子苦练数十载的五毒化身瞬间大成，不过半日就祭炼成了一种旁门禁制——五毒幡的雏形。

五毒在钱晨手中，更有凶威，就是齐秋子亲自御使，也远远比不上。
毕竟齐秋子根本没有练成五毒合击之阵，因为他的神识不够。
这《碧灵五毒化身经》的创造者一定是天生神识强大的那种人，所以创造的功法，要同时驾驱五个化身，就有这个难关，而他自己也没有想出什么好办法弥补……可钱晨的神识只会比那天赋异禀的创造者，还要天赋异禀一百万倍。这点门槛对钱晨来说根本不存在。
于是只用了半天，一个加强版的乘雾神君就新鲜出炉了。
钱晨穿着一件青袍，带着诡异的蛇脸青铜面具，用着一种嘶嘶的语气说道：“齐秋子我还是难以模仿，毕竟他熟人太多，一举一动，都有人注意。嘶嘶……虽然我能骗得过寻常人等，但也不是毫无破绽，要谨慎…嘶嘶…但乘雾神君，却是齐秋子的一个暗中身份。”
“他一直很注意在同伴面前掩饰自己的任何特征，这种伪装，就像一层天然的保护。”
“除了龙首那里可能还有一点我不知道的其他线索，有可能会暴露出我来，其他元辰，绝对看不出乘雾神君是我假扮的。”
钱晨支起天罗伞一转，又换回了之前的年轻士子摸样：“我还是以这个身份混进四海堂。暗中面见其他十一元辰时，才用乘雾神君的身份。只是有一个问题……我该如何混进四海堂呢？总不是什么阿猫阿狗都能进去参加寿宴吧！”
钱晨将齐秋子的其他杂物都一把火烧掉，唯有五毒藏入龙雀环中。
他把毒药放在乾坤袋里，齐秋子神医身份的药囊杂物，也被扔进了乾坤袋，以防有什么要用这个身份的情况。
钱晨闭了茶摊，伪装成店家有事打烊的情况，便径直入临海城中。
临海大城此时热闹非凡，往来的都是提刀舞枪的江湖中人，而四海堂作为这里的主人也是热情招待，一面还要警惕查探，维持秩序，仅仅钱晨入城的这段时间里，他就目睹了三起江湖人的口角械斗……端是十分的混乱。
“我到了四海堂……可我应该如何进去呢？”钱晨望着四海堂的大门牌坊低头思索，四海堂果然不是什么阿猫阿狗都能进去的，若是贵客，自然有人通报，由四海堂的高层出门相迎。
“气吞丹霞，梁斗梁宗师到！”
四海堂门口迎宾的弟子高声道……
“梁宗师，本堂掌门若是知道他七十大寿，有梁宗师亲自来贺，必然欣喜。真叫本堂蓬荜生辉……”一位脸色赤红，显然是四海堂地位极高的首领的中年人热情的迎了出来，这位梁宗师其貌不扬，带着几位随侍弟子，与四海堂红脸首领携手走进正门。
端是声势浩大，气氛热烈。
钱晨缩在四海堂门口的角落里，他一副文弱士子的打扮，好像十分羡慕的看着这一幕。
（本章完）

Chapter 11 Swallowing Danxia in anger
"Is this golden snake the Five Poisons of Jade Phosphorus?" Qian Chen took out the limp golden snake from the dragon bird ring.
"It is a green phosphorous golden snake, one of the five poisons. It is my way of becoming famous. After joining the Twelve Yuanchen, I robbed countless medicinal materials and wealth... For this golden snake embryo, I bloodbathed a village in Miao territory, and even killed the only woman I had ever loved in my life..." Qi Qiuzi said this, and his soul showed a look of pain.
You must know that even if he was imprisoned by the Soul Imprisonment Talisman, he would never have such an expression of heartache.
Qian Chen was already preparing to impersonate the name Chengwu Shenjun. Of course, he had to ask Qi Qiuzi for all the details of his life. How could he miss such an important plot? Moreover, he had listened to the stories of business travelers these past few days and gradually realized that these worldly things he had never experienced before could sharpen his Taoist heart. He was probably unwilling to let Qian Chen do this by himself.
But let him listen to the story and understand the entanglements of love, hate, and resentment in the story. It is not only refreshing, but also sharpens his Taoist heart. Why not?
He immediately opened the small bench and listened to Qi Qiuzi's life experience...
"Love, hate, and hatred!" Qian Chen sighed: "You said you respect your mentor the most in your life, but do you still have any senior brothers or sisters?"
"No more, I am the only one left in the Biling Five Poison Sect." Qi Qiuzi said indifferently.
"Where's your teacher?"
"I was poisoned to death!"
Qian Chen stood up suddenly, shook his head and said, "You have really brought it upon yourself in this life."
"Recite the "Biling Five Poisons Incarnation Sutra" again, describe in detail your habits, tone, movements, poisoning techniques, and recent detailed experiences when you meet the Twelve Yuanchen."
Qian Chen lowered the curtain of the tea stall and used a hidden talisman to cover the movement here. He began to learn to imitate Qi Qiuzi's every move, listening to him talk about some interpersonal relationships and his disguise habits, and at the same time, he also studied the "Biling Five Poisons Incarnation Sutra". This "Biling Five Poisons Incarnation Sutra" does have some fantastic ideas.
Although the creator just wanted to draw a parallel and refine a strange magic weapon using poison as raw material.
But unintentionally, he has exceeded the limitations of divine weapons, and has touched upon a trace of the voodoo magic of Middle-earth and the left-field magic of the incarnation of the soul. The five poisons of green phosphorus he refined have the characteristics of living creatures and can entrust the soul. It can be regarded as a wonderful magical weapon in this world. The user drives the incarnation of the five poisons, which is equivalent to having five peerless masters with unparalleled poisons. They cooperate with each other to fight against the enemy. The creator even created a joint attack formation.
He drove out the five poisons and left a great legend in this world.
Of course, Qian Chen would not leave the resident treasure house where he currently lives. He has many ways to impersonate the God of Chengwu. These poisons have been carefully refined by Qi Qiuzi, and they already have the prototype of a magical weapon. Even in the world of Middle-earth, they are also strange insects that are coveted by the heretics.
After all, although the resources of Middle-earth are rich, they are not as powerful as the Twelve Yuan Chen of this world, which has wreaked havoc too widely and plundered countless top spiritual beings in this world. One is to use all the world to cultivate dozens of top divine weapons and warriors. The materials of the divine weapons they use are naturally perfect, and cannot be compared to those low-level monks in Middle-earth who are trembling under the oppression of the great monks of Danjie and the true soul of the soul, and their number is tens of millions times greater.
Qian Chen polished the green phosphorus golden snake carefully, took out the other four poisonous poisons that Qi Qiuzi had pressed at the bottom of the box that were not yet pure, and poured down a handful of the elixir left by Miao Kong. The incarnation of the five poisons that Qi Qiuzi had practiced for decades was instantly completed. In just half a day, it was refined into the prototype of a side door prohibition - the five poison flags.
The Five Poisons were even more powerful in Qian Chen's hands, even if Qi Qiuzi personally used them, they were far less powerful.
After all, Qi Qiuzi didn't practice the Five Poisons Combination Attack Formation at all because he didn't have enough spiritual consciousness.
The creator of this "Biling Five Poisons Incarnation Sutra" must be HeavenThe kind of person who has a strong spiritual consciousness, so the skill he created has to control five incarnations at the same time, which is a difficulty, and he himself has not come up with any good way to make up for it... But Qian Chen's spiritual consciousness is only a million times more talented than the talented creator. This threshold does not exist for Qian Chen.
So it only took half a day to create an enhanced version of Chengwu Shenjun.
Qian Chen was wearing a green robe and a weird bronze mask with a snake face, and said in a hissing tone: "Qi Qiuzi is still difficult for me to imitate. After all, he has too many acquaintances, and everyone pays attention to his every move. Hiss... Although I can deceive ordinary people, it is not without flaws, so be careful... hiss... But the Chengwu Shenjun is Qi Qiuzi's secret identity."
"He has always paid attention to concealing any of his characteristics in front of his companions. This disguise is like a layer of natural protection."
"In addition to the dragon head, there may be some other clues that I don't know about, which may expose me. Other Yuan Chen will never know that Chengwu Shenjun is me pretending to be."
Qian Chen held up his Tianluo umbrella and turned around, changing back to his previous appearance as a young scholar: "I still use this identity to sneak into the Sihai Hall. When I secretly meet the other eleven Yuanchen, I use the identity of Chengwu Shenjun. There is just one question...how should I sneak into the Sihai Hall? Not just any cat or dog can go in to attend the birthday banquet!"
Qian Chen burned all the other things belonging to Qi Qiuzi, except for the five poisons, which he hid in the dragon bird ring.
He put the poison in the Qiankun bag, and the miscellaneous medicine bags of Qi Qiuzi's identity as a miracle doctor were also thrown into the Qiankun bag, just in case there was any need to use his identity.
Qian Chen closed the tea stall, pretended that the store was closed for business, and went straight into Linhai City.
The big city near the sea was bustling with activity at this time, and the people coming and going were all Jianghu people with swords and guns. Sihaitang, as the owner here, also warmly entertained people, while also being vigilant in investigating and maintaining order. During the time Qian Chen only entered the city, he witnessed three quarreling and armed fights between Jianghu people... It was very chaotic.
"I've arrived at Sihaitang... but how should I get in?" Qian Chen looked at the gate arch of Sihaitang and thought with his head down. Sure enough, Sihaitang is not something that just any cat or dog can enter. If he is a distinguished guest, someone will naturally notify him and the top brass of Sihaitang will go out to greet him.
"Swallowing Danxia in anger, Grandmaster Liang Douliang has arrived!"
The disciples welcoming guests at the entrance of Sihai Hall said loudly...
"Grandmaster Liang, if the head of this hall knew that Grandmaster Liang came to congratulate him in person on his seventieth birthday, he would be delighted. It really brings glory to this hall..." A middle-aged man with a red face, who was obviously a very high-ranking leader of the Sihaitang, greeted him enthusiastically. Grandmaster Liang, who was not handsome in appearance, walked into the main entrance hand in hand with a few disciples and the red-faced leader of the Sihaitang.
It was very loud and the atmosphere was warm.
Qian Chen huddled in the corner at the entrance of Sihaitang. He was dressed like a weak scholar and seemed to be watching this scene with envy.
(End of chapter)
